results.prop: P2B1 per-step soundness of the P2 test: a positive cr_margin, the navigation error inside (e_h, e_h, e_z) and the true displacement inside the per-axis reach keep the true centre out of the CR
results.formula: sep_k(q, R, err, slack) & |e| <= err & -R- <= x <= R+ -> not inside_CR(q + e + x)
results.note: e_h 1.0 m, e_z 1.0 m, slack 0.05 m; the command of a step is applied for dt = 0.1 s <= tau_c = 0.35 s, inside the first phase of its own backup

results.prop: P2B1r the deployed axis_reach does not under-estimate the exact maximum of the envelope integral (numeric, dense grid)
results.formula: forall (u0, u) in grid: axis_reach >= exact - err_kinks, err_kinks < SLACK_M
results.note: 14641 pairs per side, |u| <= 0.6 m/s; largest under-estimate 5.74e-05 m at (-0.6, 0.56, '+'); analytic bound of the trapezoidal/sampling error (4 kinks, a h^2 / 8, h = 0.0323 s) 2.61e-04 m; SLACK_M 0.05 m

results.prop: P2B2 recursive feasibility of the one-step margin: a command P2-safe with one-step margin above Delta = 0.179 m leaves braking P2-safe at the next step; holding at the stage-2 target (margin 0.100 m) stays P2-safe while the realised drift of a step is within its bound (numeric, grid)
results.formula: forall grid (u0, u): x(dt) + R(v(dt), 0) + delta_e - R(u0, u) <= Delta; hold margin > Delta_hold
results.note: 7442 cases, |u| <= 0.6 m/s, dt 0.1 s; worst Delta 0.179 m at (u0, u, side) (-0.6, -0.6, '+') (a fast motion away from that side: the envelope lets it stop at once at the next step); worst Delta when neither the velocity nor the command points away 0.029 m, with |u0|, |u| <= 0.3 m/s 0.104 m; Delta of a hold 0.029 m (drift w dt + change of the navigation error 0.0136 m per step from the NavBound coefficients).  This describes the ONE-STEP margin (cr_margin without lookahead); the deployed selection uses the robust margin (P2B5) and the anchored station keeping (P2B4)

results.prop: P2B2s scope: strict invariance of the one-step P2-safe set fails (one-step margin > 0 does not imply a P2-safe braking at the next step): the latency phase and its drift are applied again at every step
results.formula: expect a grid case with x(dt) + R(v(dt), 0) > R(u0, u)
results.note: 4438 of 7442 cases with a positive deficit, worst 0.179 m at (-0.6, -0.6, '+'): a command chosen on its one-step margin below it may leave no P2-safe command at the next step.  The deployed selection therefore uses the robust margin (P2B5: braking stays P2-safe from every worst-case state after dt) and the anchored station keeping (P2B4)

results.prop: P2B3 adversarial trajectories: no command called P2-safe by the deployed filter lets a true trajectory inside the declared envelope into the CR (numeric)
results.formula: forall sampled (q, v0, u) with margin > 0 and admissible profiles: true centre not in CR
results.note: 20700 trajectories (1500 states near the CR, up to 5 P2-safe candidate commands each, 8 extreme per-axis combinations at the error corners + 2 random), sampled every 10 ms; 0 entered the CR

results.prop: P2B4 station keeping on a latched anchor: over the states of the unsaturated position loop (deviation within e_track, the loop velocity at that deviation plus the drift) the margin equals that of the anchor (time-invariant), and with the measured velocity within v_err it stays positive at the stage-2 target (numeric)
results.formula: forall anchors, |e_k| <= e_track, v = k (a - q) + d: hold_margin(q, v) = hold_margin(a, 0); with v_err: hold_margin > 0 at the stage-2 target
results.note: 101250 loop states, 5 anchors (stage-2 target, beside, above, below, beyond the gate), gains 0.5 / 0.6, cap 0.27 m/s, drift +-0.15 per axis; exact invariance with the true velocity: largest drop 0.00e+00 m.  With the measured velocity within v_err 0.098 m/s (DVL 3 sigma) the braking term of hold_margin can exceed the anchor term at the edge of the deviation band: largest drop 0.045 m at ([-2.5525, 0.0, 0.0], [0.3, -0.3, -0.3], [0.098, 0.098, 0.098]), so the onboard margin is time-invariant only up to that amount; stage-2 target margin min 0.055 m.  40 deviation/gain cases saturate the loop (|k e| > the cap): there the deviation bound e_track needs the drift vector below HOLD_V_MAX (the per-axis bound gives sqrt(3) w = 0.26 m/s > 0.27).  Deviation and velocity taken independently (states the loop does not produce): min -0.093 m

results.prop: P2B5 robust selection: every command returned by the deployed warning filter, escape (station-keeping HOLD) or filter_mission with a positive robust margin leaves braking one-step P2-safe from every worst-case state after dt (numeric, grid)
results.formula: forall returned u with robust margin > 0, corners of the state after dt: one-step margin of braking > 0
results.note: 4772 returned commands (63 threat sets x 2 planners, 9 mission commands; 16 positions x 4 velocities; HOLD answers are station keeping, P2B4); worst next-step braking margin 0.046 m; 0 failures from the true worst-case state.  As computed onboard at the next step (velocity measured within v_err 0.098 m/s and filtered with it) braking is not P2-safe in 744 of them: there the next step relies on station keeping (P2B4) or another candidate, not on braking

results.prop: P2B6 the CR column: no command called P2-safe lets a true trajectory inside the declared envelope pass under or over the CR (cr_s_min <= s <= cr_s_max, |l| <= cr_half_width at any depth; numeric)
results.formula: forall sampled (q above or below the CR, v0, u) with robust margin > 0: true (s, l) never in the CR footprint
results.note: 9960 trajectories from 900 states 1-4 m above or below the CR centre (extreme s, l profiles at the error corners and random ones, any vertical profile); 0 reached the column

results.prop: P2B6m mutation: with the forbidden set the CR box (column=False) commands called safe let the drone pass under or over the CR
results.formula: expect a sampled trajectory inside the CR footprint
